relationship_notes: French boutique builder founded around 2020 by Gaëtan Villette and Christophe, with Pierre-Benoît joining the team. First-party and press sources describe original circuits designed and built in France; the early releases included Doomer Fuzz, Echosmos, La Montagne and Extinction Drive, followed by bass-focused Chaosculpt Bass and The Empress Bass. Preserve Doomer Fuzz v2 and La Montagne v2 as generation states for Protocol B rather than separate builder identities.
